name: Jade Cloud
before_label: Round 9's Jade Cloud with its even grain (in the round 9 archive)
change: Milky clouds inside the glass in a few soft patches, like the clouds in nephrite jade; a fine grain gathers inside the clouds, with a few dark mineral specks.
good: The grain now gathers inside the milky clouds, fine and uneven, the way inclusions make up the clouds in real jade, and the clear glass between the clouds stays clean.
watch: On a 1x screen the grain inside the clouds reads slightly sandy; the few dark specks are almost too faint to find.

name: Mottled Slab
before_label: Round 9's Mottled Slab with its even grain (in the round 9 archive)
change: Small lighter and darker mottles in broad patches, like serpentine or soapstone; fine dark grain gathers in the dark mottles and paler grain in the light ones.
good: Fine dark grain makes up the dark mottles and a paler grain the light ones, so the stone looks made of grains rather than dusted with them.
watch: The dark mottles read a little stronger than in round 9, and up close their grain can look like camera noise.

name: Through the jade
change: The glow shines through the glass and stone: brighter where the jade is milky or light, dimmer through dark mottles and uneven frosting, so it changes shape as it moves.
good: The glow catches in the milky clouds and light mottles and dims through dark mottles and uneven frosting, so it changes shape as it moves, like light inside the stone.
watch: Subtle: its brightness varies between about 0.7 and 1.3 times round 9's glow, so in a still view it can pass for the old light.

name: Refracted
change: Also bent by the glass: soft veins of brighter light inside the glow move less far than the glow, so it ripples and reshapes as it travels.
good: Closest to the request: soft veins of brighter light inside the glow move more slowly than the glow, so it ripples and reshapes as it travels.
watch: The most visible change to the light; stronger, its veins would read as smoke.
